verdict.rationale:
Foreloop lets a PM describe work in plain language ('Users can't tell which invoices are overdue') without knowing which files change, have an agent claim it, implement it, open a PR, and require human approval (from a phone) before anything lands — this covers the 'no engineering handoff' spirit of the story. However, there is no documented capability to ingest an actual mockup/design file (e.g. Figma) as the starting artifact; the closest is a feedback widget where users point at a live page element with a screenshot, not a design mockup.
missing for 10: direct mockup/design-file ingestion (e.g. Figma import), end-to-end example going from a design asset to merged implementation.
